agent_report.recommendation_rationale: ~85% of claims are covered by the combination of 3 new extractions + 3 pre-existing sources. Uncovered claims are mostly specific numeric parameters (electrode radius, current, LCOE) that appear in the JFE paper's full text or the unextracted timelines page. The two peer-reviewed papers (Lerner 2023, Lerner 2024) are higher-authority sources for the technical claims than the company website.
